user.title: SB Modes
user.description: Adds the mode select, a status sensor per zone and a problem sensor. It starts with four modes (morning, day, evening, overnight) that do nothing until you give them behaviours.

check_config.description: Validates a mode table without saving it.

save_config.name: Save mode table

config.name: Table
config.description: The whole mode table: fallback_mode, modes, zones.

set_mode.name: Set mode
set_mode.description: Switch the house to a mode by hand, held against the schedule.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: A mode id from the table, e.g. overnight.

hold.name: Hold
hold.description: next = until the next scheduled change (default); paused = until the schedule is resumed; a number = that many minutes, then back to the scheduled mode.

resume_schedule.name: Resume schedule
resume_schedule.description: End any manual hold and switch to the mode the schedule says now.

hold_zone.name: Hold zone
hold_zone.description: Hold a zone by hand: its behaviour sends nothing to its lights.

hold.name: Hold
hold.description: next = until the next mode change (default); paused = until released; a number = that many minutes.

release_zone.name: Release zone
release_zone.description: End a zone's hold and its lights changed by hand; its behaviour starts again for the current mode.
